description: 6 MiB flood: viewer P credits promptly (all bytes, one paint); viewer S (observe) never credits until the flood ended and its socket goes unread while P drains (stalls at the 256 KiB window; the >4 MiB backlog is replaced by a repaint that arrives before the late credit)

argv: sleep 1; head -c 6291456 /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'x' | fold -w 99; echo; echo END-OF-FLOOD; sleep 600
terminal.name: flood
